changes.summary: New chapter: assumption-family definition, substitution error, binary coupling family, two-factor linear theorem (ranking preserved, additivity test and S_i<=S_Ti fail, threshold flips at rho=-3/5), duplicated-information theorem (first-order reversal at |rho|>1/2, total reversal at |rho|>sqrt3/2), factor-fixing theorem (independent bound 2V S_Ti versus failure under dependence), formulation theorem (equal baseline derivatives; ranking reverses at gamma^2>45/4; threshold flips at gamma=0), reporting method, worked report tables, limitations warning.
Full proofs for the five body results.
